question: Who won the IIFA 2025 Outstanding Achievement Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakesh Roshan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **IIFA 2025 Outstanding Achievement Award** was presented to **Rakesh Roshan**, a renowned filmmaker and actor.
 
• Rakesh Roshan has made significant contributions to Indian cinema, both as a director and producer.
 
• This special honor was awarded to him at the **silver jubilee edition** of the IIFA Awards, which was held in **Jaipur**, Rajasthan, on **March 8-9, 2025**.
 
• His work in the Bollywood industry has left a lasting legacy, making him a highly respected figure in the entertainment industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laapataa Ladies** won the **maximum number of awards** at the IIFA 2025, including** Best Film and Best Direction**.
 
• **Kartik Aaryan** won the** Best Actor award** for his role in "**Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**".
 
• **Nitanshi Goel** took home the **Best Actress award** for "**Laapataa Ladies**".
 
• The IIFA 2025 event was a grand celebration of Bollywood and its rich cultural contribution.
